name: ai-automatic-grader-tool
description: Monorepo root scripts for Cloudflare Workers Builds / local tooling.

scripts.build: npm ci --prefix AGT_platform/frontend && npm run build --prefix AGT_platform/frontend && rm -f AGT_platform/frontend/dist/_redirects
scripts.deploy:frontend: npm run build && npx wrangler deploy --config wrangler.toml --var API_ORIGIN:"$API_ORIGIN"
